title: DCM Bandits: Multiplayer Information Asymmetric Cascading Bandits for Multiple Clicks
abstract: arXiv:2608.11873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work, we extend the Dependent Click Model (DCM) Bandits to a multiplayer information-asymmetric setting, where multiple agents interact with a shared ranked list and may observe multiple clicks per session, introducing new challenges for selection strategies. We study asymmetry in (1) actions and (2) rewards, providing sublinear regret guarantees for three settings where at least one asymmetry is present. Establishing matching information-theoretic lower bounds for these settings is left as an open problem. We further show that for small termination probabilities, the termination ranking need not be known, improving on prior single-agent results. Experiments confirm that our algorithms perform well across asymmetric environments and highlight the critical role of feedback structure, specifically the distinction between full versus first-click feedback, in coordinating exploration and minimizing regret.

translated_title: DCM老虎机：多玩家信息不对称级联老虎机用于多次点击
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们将依赖点击模型（DCM）老虎机扩展到多人信息不对称场景，其中多个代理与一个共享的排名列表交互，并且每个会话可能观察到多次点击，这为选择策略带来了新的挑战。我们研究了（1）行动和（2）奖励方面的不对称性，并为至少存在一种不对称性的三种设置提供了次线性遗憾保证。为这些设置建立匹配的信息论下界仍是一个未解决的问题。我们进一步表明，对于较小的终止概率，终止排名无需已知，从而改进了先前的单代理结果。实验证实，我们的算法在不对称环境中表现良好，并强调了反馈结构的关键作用，特别是完整反馈与首次点击反馈之间的区别，在协调探索和最小化遗憾方面至关重要。
tldr: 本文提出了一种多人信息不对称级联老虎机算法，扩展了DCM模型以处理多次点击，并在行动或奖励不对称时实现次线性遗憾，同时揭示了反馈结构对探索协调的关键影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a multiplayer information-asymmetric cascading bandit algorithm extending the DCM model to handle multiple clicks, achieving sublinear regret under action or reward asymmetry, and highlighting the critical role of feedback structure in coordinating exploration.
